ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, a square is placed on a desk. What is the side length of this square?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram, \\
$\because$ $\angle B = \angle D = \angle ACE = 90^\circ$, \\
$\angle BAC + \angle ACB = 90^\circ$, $\angle ECD + \angle ACB = 90^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle BAC = \angle ECD$, \\
$\because$ AC = CE, \\
$\therefore$ $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle CBE$, \\
$\therefore$ BC = DE = 2, \\
$\therefore$ AC = $\sqrt{AB^2 + BC^2} = \sqrt{1^2 + 2^2} = \sqrt{5}$, \\
$\therefore$ the length of the side of the square is $\boxed{\sqrt{5}}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a tilted square placed on a horizontal tabletop, and the lower vertex of the square touches the tabletop. The left vertex is supported to the tabletop by a vertical segment, with height 1 marked beside it; the right vertex is supported to the tabletop by a vertical segment, with height 2 marked beside it. The tabletop is a horizontal straight line, the two supports are perpendicular to the tabletop, and right angles are also marked in the figure. Label the figure according to the method: Let C be the vertex below the square that touches the tabletop, A be the left vertex, and E be the right vertex; B and D are respectively the feet of the perpendiculars from A and E to the tabletop. Thus AB=1, DE=2, B, C, D are collinear, AB⊥tabletop, DE⊥tabletop. Because adjacent sides of a square are equal and perpendicular, AC=CE and AC⊥CE. Reasoning: In right triangle ABC, ∠ABC=90°, so ∠BAC+∠ACB=90°. Also because AC⊥CE, and CB and CD are on the same horizontal straight line, ∠ACB+∠ECD=90°. Therefore ∠BAC=∠ECD. Triangles ABC and CDE are both right triangles, the hypotenuses AC=CE, and there is a pair of equal acute angles, so △ABC≅△CDE. From equality of corresponding sides, BC=DE=2, AB=CD=1. Thus the side length AC of the square satisfies AC=√(AB²+BC²)=√(1²+2²)=√5 in right triangle ABC. Final answer: √5.

method.method_draft: Assign labels from the figure: let C be the lower vertex of the tilted square touching the desk, A the left vertex supported by the vertical segment of height 1, E the right vertex supported by the vertical segment of height 2, and let B,D be the feet of those vertical supports on the desk. Read from the image that AB=1, DE=2, B,C,D are collinear on the horizontal desk, AB and DE are perpendicular to the desk, and the square gives AC=CE and AC ⟂ CE. Use angle chasing: since ∠ABC=∠CDE=90° and ∠ACB plus ∠ECD add to 90° because AC ⟂ CE and CB,CD lie on the same straight desk line, the acute angles ∠BAC and ∠ECD are equal. Thus right triangles ABC and CDE are congruent by hypotenuse-and-acute-angle, using AC=CE. Therefore BC=DE=2 and AB=CD=1. Then compute the square side AC by the Pythagorean theorem in right triangle ABC: AC=sqrt(AB^2+BC^2)=sqrt(1^2+2^2)=sqrt(5).

图像描述：图中有一个倾斜的正方形放在水平桌面上，正方形的下方顶点接触桌面。左侧顶点由一段竖直支撑到桌面，旁边标有高度 1；右侧顶点由一段竖直支撑到桌面，旁边标有高度 2。桌面是水平直线，两个支撑与桌面垂直，图中也标出了直角。按方法给图形标记：令 C 为正方形下方接触桌面的顶点，A 为左侧顶点，E 为右侧顶点；B、D 分别为 A、E 到桌面的垂足。于是 AB=1，DE=2，B、C、D 共线，AB⊥桌面，DE⊥桌面。因为正方形相邻边相等且垂直，所以 AC=CE 且 AC⊥CE。
推理：在直角三角形 ABC 中，∠ABC=90°，所以 ∠BAC+∠ACB=90°。又因为 AC⊥CE，且 CB、CD 在同一条水平直线上，所以 ∠ACB+∠ECD=90°。因此 ∠BAC=∠ECD。三角形 ABC 与三角形 CDE 都是直角三角形，斜边 AC=CE，且有一组锐角相等，所以 △ABC≅△CDE。由对应边相等得 BC=DE=2，AB=CD=1。于是正方形边长 AC 在直角三角形 ABC 中满足 AC=√(AB²+BC²)=√(1²+2²)=√5。最终答案：√5。

method.method_draft: Use a coordinate/vector setup. From the image, take the desk as the x-axis and the lower vertex C of the square as the origin. Let A be the left adjacent vertex of the square; because A is on a vertical support labeled 1, its height above the desk is 1, so vector CA has vertical component 1 and points up-left. Let E be the right adjacent vertex of the square; because E is on a vertical support labeled 2, vector CE has vertical component 2 and points up-right. Since AC and CE are adjacent sides of a square, CE is a 90° rotation of CA with the same length. If CA=(-p,1), then the clockwise 90° rotation has components (1,p). Matching the image-side height of E gives p=2. Hence CA=(-2,1), so the side length of the square is |CA|=sqrt((-2)^2+1^2)=sqrt(5).

推理：按指定坐标法，把桌面作为 x 轴，把正方形下方顶点 C 作为原点。设从 C 到左邻顶点 A 的向量为 CA=(-p, 1)，其中竖直分量为 1，因为 A 的高度是 1，水平分量为负，因为 A 在 C 的左侧。正方形相邻边 AC 和 CE 等长且垂直，因此向量 CE 可看作向量 CA 顺时针旋转 90° 得到。向量 (-p, 1) 顺时针旋转 90° 后为 (1, p)。由图中右邻顶点 E 的高度为 2，可知 CE 的竖直分量 p=2。因此 CA=(-2, 1)。正方形边长就是 |CA|=sqrt((-2)^2+1^2)=sqrt(5)。

verify_reports.critic_suggestions: 该推理链整体正确：先描述图像再推理，符合多模态顺序要求；视觉描述与图中水平桌面、倾斜正方形、左侧高度1、右侧高度2、下方顶点接触桌面及直角标记相符；坐标/向量方法与指定 Method Draft 基本一致，最终得到边长 sqrt(5)，与标准答案一致。唯一可轻微改进处是明确说明坐标系中 y 轴竖直向上，以及 CE 是由 CA 顺时针旋转 90° 后得到，以避免旋转方向歧义。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, a square is placed on a desk. What is the side length of this square?
raw_record.answer:
As shown in the diagram,
$\because$ $\angle B = \angle D = \angle ACE = 90^\circ$,
$\angle BAC + \angle ACB = 90^\circ$, $\angle ECD + \angle ACB = 90^\circ$,
$\therefore$ $\angle BAC = \angle ECD$,
$\because$ AC = CE,
$\therefore$ $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle CBE$,
$\therefore$ BC = DE = 2,
$\therefore$ AC = $\sqrt{AB^2 + BC^2} = \sqrt{1^2 + 2^2} = \sqrt{5}$,
$\therefore$ the length of the side of the square is $\boxed{\sqrt{5}}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure there is a tilted square placed on a horizontal tabletop, and the lower vertex of the square touches the tabletop. The left vertex is supported to the tabletop by a vertical segment, with height 1 marked beside it; the right vertex is supported to the tabletop by a vertical segment, with height 2 marked beside it. The tabletop is a horizontal straight line, the two supports are perpendicular to the tabletop, and right angles are also marked in the figure. Label the figure according to the method: Let C be the vertex below the square that touches the tabletop, A be the left vertex, and E be the right vertex; B and D are respectively the feet of the perpendiculars from A and E to the tabletop. Thus AB=1, DE=2, B, C, D are collinear, AB⊥tabletop, DE⊥tabletop. Because adjacent sides of a square are equal and perpendicular, AC=CE and AC⊥CE.
Reasoning: In right triangle ABC, ∠ABC=90°, so ∠BAC+∠ACB=90°. Also because AC⊥CE, and CB and CD are on the same horizontal straight line, ∠ACB+∠ECD=90°. Therefore ∠BAC=∠ECD. Triangles ABC and CDE are both right triangles, the hypotenuses AC=CE, and there is a pair of equal acute angles, so △ABC≅△CDE. From equality of corresponding sides, BC=DE=2, AB=CD=1. Thus the side length AC of the square satisfies AC=√(AB²+BC²)=√(1²+2²)=√5 in right triangle ABC. Final answer: √5.
